sentences.text: The National Clearinghouse on Family Violence distributed a catalogue of Canadian videos on family violence for the general public and for professionals working in the field.
The National Clearinghouse on Family Violence is a resource centre for Canadians seeking information on violence in relationships of kinship, intimacy, dependency, or trust.

The National Clearinghouse on Family Violence provides resources and services available free of charge in both English and French, including more than 140 publications such as overview papers, reports, discussion papers and handbooks on family violence issues.
The National Clearinghouse on Family Violence operates a referral and directory service of resource people and organizations responding to family violence.

The National Clearinghouse on Family Violence maintains a comprehensive library reference collection and on-line bibliographic searching of approximately 10,000 books, periodicals and videos on family violence.

The Clearinghouse produces and distributes printed resources on all forms of family violence for professionals and the public, and operates a toll-free telephone service to provide information on programs and services across the country.
The Clearinghouse handles over 1000 enquiries each month.
The Clearinghouse maintains a collection of films available to the public through offices of the National Film Board, and over 8.5 million Canadians have seen these films.
